spans.s: सभा f. 1. An assembly, a council, न सा सभा यत्र न संति वृद्धाः Hit.i.; 2. a much frequented place; 3. a court of justice; 4. a public audience, a levee; 5. a gambling house.
सभा-आस्तार m. an assistant at an assembly, a menber of society.
सभा-सद् m. 1. a member of any society or company, an assistant at an assembly or meeting; 2. an assessor, a judge.
सभाज् vt. 10U (pres. सभाजयति-ते) 1. To serve, to worship; 2. to gratify, to congratulate, स्नेहात् सभाजयितुमेत्य दिनान्यमूनि Ut.i.; 3. to beautify; 4. to show.
सभाजन n. 1. Courtesy, politeness; 2. thanks, R.xiii.43, xiv.18; 3. congratulation.
सभावन m. An epithet of Śiva.
सभि(भी)क m. The keeper of a gaming-house, तदर्धं सभिकाय सभ्येभ्यश्च दत्वा D.K.
सभि(भी)क m. The keeper of a gaming-house, तदर्धं सभिकाय सभ्येभ्यश्च दत्वा D.K.
सभ्य (I) a. (f. भ्या) 1. Relating to an assembly; 2. polite, R.i.55; 3. refined, civilized; 4. trusted, faithful.
सभ्य (II) m. 1. An assistant at an assembly; 2. an assessor; 3. a person of honourable parentage; 4. the keeper of a gambling house; 5. a servant of the keeper of a gaming-house.
सभ्य (I) a. (f. भ्या) 1. Relating to an assembly; 2. polite, R.i.55; 3. refined, civilized; 4. trusted, faithful.
